title: Four short scenarios, twelve searches
lede: You will practice all six menu layouts once, then complete four blocks. Each block starts with a short scenario, a check-in, and three search trials using three different menus. Every menu appears exactly twice. We are testing the website, not you, so please say candidly what you notice.

cards.title: Think aloud
cards.text: Say what you are looking for and what you notice. The researcher may prompt you but will not help you find products.

cards.title: Search naturally
cards.text: Use the menu as you would in a real shop. Practice searches last up to 15 seconds; scored searches last up to 20 seconds. A timeout is recorded honestly; you do not need to guess.

cards.title: Check in honestly
cards.text: After each scenario, rate how you feel. If distress is above 6/10, the session stops immediately.

cards.title: Stop anytime
cards.text: The visible Stop control is always available. You do not need to give a reason.

estimate: The activities are designed for approximately 15 minutes. Complete each activity at your own pace; the session does not stop automatically after 15 minutes.
